authorization: Validate higher support and complete sit/hold/stand under unchanged criteria.
defect: The previous state() used pelvis[height.argmin()] for tangential position. That material identity can jump between vertices as pitch changes, even though the minimum height is continuous. Interpolating its tangential coordinate can demand a nonexistent intermediate point.
correction: Choose one actual lowest-z rear-most pelvis collider vertex at initialization, record shape/vertex indices, and use its transformed tangential coordinate throughout. Minimum whole-pelvis clearance remains recomputed independently. Contact-footprint erosion uses offsets from that same material point over the original pitch box.
initialization: Only the measured higher-table standing snapshot q0/IMU/camera and bound reset command. No rejected pose/vector/path input.
equations: Cold constrained endpoint: original eight bilateral-foot/minimum-hover/fixed-material tangent equalities; minimize COM distance to sole center; unchanged boxes. Actual endpoint command schedule <=10.4s before33node path; each path uses fixed material tangent with continuous minimum gap. Existing independent geometry, action/filter/time and all-mesh clearance must pass.
sources: The passed current-depth audit is read/hash-bound to the exact saved frame, not recomputed. Fixed vertex membership is independently checked against original collider source. SLSQP local success is not global optimality.
return_policy: One new construction. Stop on any original gate failure. No relaxation, retiming or failed-point reuse. Fresh actual-start matching required before any newGPU motion.
